verdict.rationale: Latham's Emerging Companies & Growth page names "tailored, cost-conscious company formation services" as part of its earliest-stage work. LathamDrive groups resources under a "Formation" stage and offers a document generator that creates "the documents necessary to incorporate a company," so formation is a documented part of the startup practice. Missing for 10: no itemized evidence that the engagement covers the charter, bylaws, initial board consents and founder stock purchase agreements specifically, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the formation service.
